citations.citation: Murrell B, Wertheim JO, Moola S, Weighill T, Scheffler K, Kosakovsky Pond SL (2012). Detecting Individual Sites Subject to Episodic Diversifying Selection. PLoS Genet 8(7): e1002764.

analysis.description: MEME (Mixed Effects Model of Evolution) estimates site-wise synonymous (alpha) and two-category non-synonymous rates (beta1 with p1, and beta+ with p+), using a likelihood ratio test for episodic diversifying selection.
analysis.name: Mixed Effects Model of Evolution

codon_mg94.description: Muse-Gaut 1994 x GTR codon model with shared global omega

nucleotide_gtr.description: General Time Reversible nucleotide model with empirical frequencies

beta_plus.description: Non-synonymous rate for positive selection component

branch_ebf.description: Map of branch names to Empirical Bayes Factors (EBF >= 1.0) under positive selection

branches_under_selection.description: Number of branches with empirical Bayes factor >= 100

lrt.description: Likelihood ratio test statistic for episodic diversification

mean_substitution_surprise.description: Mean Shannon perplexity surprise across substitution events at this site

nonsynonymous_substitutions.description: Count of non-synonymous substitutions at this site

p_plus.description: Weight allocated to positive selection component

p_value.description: Asymptotic p-value from mixture chi^2 distribution

substitution_history.description: Formatted string of observed substitution events at this site

synonymous_substitutions.description: Count of synonymous substitutions at this site

total_branch_length.description: Total length of branches contributing to inference at this site

site_level_summary.distribution: Asymptotic Chi-squared Mixture (0.333 chi^2_0 + 0.300 chi^2_1 + 0.367 chi^2_2)
site_level_summary.null_hypothesis: beta+ <= alpha or p+ = 0 (No episodic positive selection)
